steps.title: Configure Universal ZXing MultiFormatReader
steps.description: Expanded supported format hints to include Aztec, QR, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, ITF, Codabar, Data Matrix, and PDF417.

steps.title: Enable Continuous Camera Auto-Focus
steps.description: Added camera parameters configuration to enable FOCUS_MODE_CONTINUOUS_PICTURE and FOCUS_MODE_CONTINUOUS_VIDEO for sharp live scanning.

steps.title: Enhance Live Camera Preview Frame Decoding
steps.description: Implemented multi-orientation Y-plane byte array rotation fallback to detect vertical and tilted codes seamlessly in real-time.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Angle Gallery Image Decoder
steps.description: Built image gallery scanning pipeline attempting decodes across 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270° bitmap rotations with RGBLuminanceSource.

steps.title: Add High-Resolution Image Scaling Safeguard
steps.description: Added dynamic image downscaling fallback to prevent OutOfMemory errors while retaining barcode sharpness for large photo pickers.

steps.title: Unify Common Result Handling Logic
steps.description: Unified camera scanner and gallery upload callbacks into a shared result handler that pre-fills full decoded values without truncation.

steps.title: Support Long Text, URLs & Serial Numbers
steps.description: Ensured Exide Solar URLs, website links, IMEI numbers, and long serial strings are preserved completely in Barcode and Code fields.

steps.title: Validate Stock Movement & Product Form Operations
steps.description: Verified auto-navigation to Stock IN, Stock OUT, Product Details, or New Product creation based on active scanner context.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Language Compatibility
steps.description: Enforced standard anonymous inner classes and Temurin 17 Java 8 build compliance.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile final debug APK with universal QR/barcode camera and gallery upload scanning.
